claims.text: rain runs down a bus window at night while the city slides past outside
The bus interior is dark and quiet; a low engine hum, soft rain patter, and faint muffled street traffic accompany the view.
Drops bead, merge and crawl down the glass while city lights blur into amber, white and blue bokeh.
Streetlights and shop signs smear into sideways streaks across the wet pane.

json.soundscape: Low bus engine hum; soft rain patter and small ticks on glass; faint muffled traffic and tire hiss beyond the pane.

summary.text: A close, quiet observation of rain on a night bus window as city lights blur and streak past.

description.text: The dark glass of a bus window fills the close view at night, its surface beaded with rain. The drops sit trembling in place, then gather weight, merge and begin to crawl downward in wavering silver trails, each one dragging a thin wake behind it. Beyond the wet pane the city has collapsed into soft out-of-focus discs of amber, white and cold blue light that hover and drift slightly as the vehicle moves. A faint dim reflection of the dark bus interior ghosts over the glass without resolving into anything. The rain thickens briefly, and more droplets slip loose from the upper edge of the frame.
A low engine hum and the soft patter of rain on glass.
Rain beads across the dark window; distant city lights blur into amber, white and blue discs.
Several drops merge and start to slide down the pane in silver trails.
The city lights drift slightly beyond the glass as the bus moves.
The rain patter thickens to a soft, steady tick.

The same rain-streaked bus window holds in view as the bus carries it along the street. Long smeared streaks of streetlamps, shop signs and passing headlights rake across the wet glass, sliding sideways and stretching as they go. Individual droplets break apart under the sweep of light and re-form farther along the pane, their shadows thickening and thinning. The bokeh behind them flares briefly before fading back into the dark, and a fresh cluster of raindrops gathers near the lower corner and begins to run.
The bus engine continues low under the rain.
Streetlamp and shop-sign light smears sideways across the wet glass.
Droplets break apart and re-form farther along the pane.
Passing headlights flare briefly in the bokeh and then fade.
A fresh cluster of rain gathers near the lower corner and begins to run.
